overall_goal: Prepare a secondary dish by adding yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, and water to a saucepan, and frying onions and chillies in a separate pan

goals.description: Clear the Pyrex bowl and dry hands
goals.rationale: The person moves a Pyrex bowl to the sink, pours out its water, and dries their hands on a napkin.

goals.description: Add yogurt and water to the saucepan and stir
goals.rationale: The person adds yogurt and water from a kettle to the saucepan, then stirs the contents while adjusting the hob's heat.

goals.description: Add more water to the saucepan and cover it
goals.rationale: The person removes the lid, pours additional water from the kettle into the saucepan, and replaces the lid.

goals.description: Store the yogurt in the fridge
goals.rationale: The person picks up the yogurt cup from the counter and places it back into the fridge.

goals.description: Open the garlic and ginger paste jar and rinse the spoon
goals.rationale: The person opens a jar of garlic and ginger paste and rinses a teaspoon under the tap to prepare for adding the paste.

goals.description: Add garlic and ginger paste to the saucepan and stir
goals.rationale: The person removes the saucepan lid, scoops garlic and ginger paste into the pan, stirs the mixture, and replaces the lid.

goals.description: Store the garlic and ginger paste in the fridge
goals.rationale: The person picks up the jar of garlic and ginger paste and returns it to the fridge.

goals.description: Prepare the frying pan with oil
goals.rationale: The person repositions the pans, lights the burner, and adds oil to the frying pan from a bottle.
The person takes green chillies from a box, counts them, and washes them under the tap.

goals.description: Wash the knife and slice the chillies
goals.rationale: The person plucks the chili stalks, washes a knife with soap, and uses it to slice and split the chillies on the chopping board.

goals.description: Add onions to the frying pan and stir
goals.rationale: The person transfers chopped onions from a bowl into the frying pan and stirs them with a teaspoon.
